name: Enoch (Cain's son)
title: Cain's firstborn, namesake of the city
summary: Enoch was Cain's son. Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch. This Enoch must not be confused with Enoch in Seth's lineage who walked with God.

keyEvents.title: The City Named After Enoch
keyEvents.description: Cain built a city and named it after his son Enoch.
